info.name: Apache Oozie REST Admin Job API

params.name: job-id
params.description: The Oozie job identifier (workflow, coordinator, bundle, or action ID).

params.name: show
params.description: Type of information to return.

params.name: timezone
params.description: Timezone for date formatting.

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset for action pagination within the job.

params.name: len
params.description: Number of actions to return.

params.name: format
params.description: Graph format (only when show=graph).

params.name: logfilter
params.description: Log filter (only when show=log) as semicolon-delimited key=value pairs.

items.docs: Returns information, definition, logs, or graph for a specific job. Use the show parameter to control response type: info (default), definition, log, graph.

params.name: job-id
params.description: The Oozie job identifier (workflow, coordinator, bundle, or action ID).

params.name: action
params.description: Action to apply to the job.

params.name: value
params.description: Value parameter for change/sla-change/sla-disable/sla-enable actions.

params.name: type
params.description: Rerun type (action or date) for coord-rerun action.

params.name: scope
params.description: Scope of actions to rerun (e.g., 1-2 for action range, date range for date type).

params.name: refresh
params.description: Whether to refresh coordinator configuration on rerun.

params.name: nocleanup
params.description: Whether to skip cleanup of workflow output directories on rerun.

items.docs: Apply a management action to a specific job. Supported actions: start, suspend, resume, kill, dryrun, rerun, coord-rerun, bundle-rerun, change, ignore, sla-change, sla-disable, sla-enable.

info.name: Apache Oozie Get Job Info v2

params.name: job-id
params.description: The Oozie job identifier (workflow, coordinator, bundle, or action ID).

params.name: show
params.description: Type of information to return.

params.name: timezone
params.description: Timezone for date formatting.

params.name: type
params.description: Filter type for allruns (action).

params.name: action-list
params.description: Comma-separated action IDs for missing-dependencies or SLA operations.

items.docs: Version 2 of job information retrieval. Supports additional show options: errorlog, auditlog, status, jmstopic, retries, allruns, missing-dependencies.

params.name: job-id
params.description: The Oozie job identifier (workflow, coordinator, bundle, or action ID).

params.name: action
params.description: Action to apply to the job.

params.name: type
params.description: Ignore type (action).

params.name: scope
params.description: Scope of actions to ignore (e.g., 3-4).

params.name: value
params.description: SLA change value as key=value pairs.

params.name: action-list
params.description: Comma-separated action list for SLA enable/disable.

items.docs: Version 2 of job management. Supports additional actions: update (coordinator definition update), ignore, sla-change, sla-disable, sla-enable.
